query:
SELECT 
  (SELECT SUM(custo) FROM item_despesa_importado WHERE periodoCustoId = 60001 AND UPPER(equipamentoTag) NOT IN ('QMD 0H48', 'QMO6E54', 'QMD0H48', 'QMN1F10', 'SETOR RH', 'RRH 9F10', 'TNW 2I60')) as total_itens_validos,
  (SELECT SUM(custo) FROM item_despesa_importado WHERE periodoCustoId = 60001) as total_itens_todos
